svg.title: Evaluation: offline gate and online signals
svg.text: Evaluation: nothing ships unless it beats the gate
Any change to the prompt, model, chunking, reranker or guardrail goes through the same offline gate. Production feedback grows the test set every week.
leads; bad ones join golden set
new failure cases feed the golden set
Business KPI the bot is judged on: deflection rate (chats closed without a ticket within 24 h). Target 35% in quarter one, without CSAT dropping.
